data.text: MMDA ADVISORY: The EDSA Rehabilitation Project is ongoing, affecting multiple sections of the highway. Two lanes are currently occupied along EDSA from Kalayaan to Guadalupe Bridge northbound, and from Guadalupe Bridge to Pet Plans southbound. Traffic along EDSA from Kalayaan to Guadalupe Bridge northbound, as well as from Ortigas to Guadalupe Bridge southbound, is moderate to slow moving. As of 7:58 AM, April 10 (Friday), the southbound lane at Guadalupe, EDSA was temporarily opened to help ease traffic congestion, with only one lane currently occupied. #mmda
